code='''def transform(grid):
    g=[r[:] for r in grid]
    R,C=len(g),len(g[0])
    # horizontal motif rows: rows with multiple nonzero cells
    bars=[]
    for i,row in enumerate(grid):
        vals=[x for x in row if x]
        if len(vals)>=3:
            bars.append((i, vals[0]))
            # fill between extreme occupied positions
            xs=[j for j,x in enumerate(row) if x]
            for j in range(min(xs),max(xs)+1):
                if g[i][j]==0: g[i][j]=row[next(k for k in range(j,-1,-1) if row[k]) ] if any(row[:j+1]) else vals[0]
            # ensure full motif uniform color across holes
            for j in range(min(xs),max(xs)+1): g[i][j]=vals[0]
    # marker columns are sparse vertical runs near bottom; identify isolated nonzero singletons
    counts=[sum(1 for i in range(R) if grid[i][j]) for j in range(C)]
    cols=[j for j,n in enumerate(counts) if n>=2 and n < R//2]
    for j in cols:
        # only extend above lowest marker; color by nearest horizontal bar, ties lower
        for i in range(R):
            if grid[i][j]: continue
            if bars:
                rr,col=min(bars,key=lambda x:(abs(x[0]-i), 0 if x[0]>=i else 1))
                g[i][j]=col
    return g
'''
